I'm a fully-funded **PhD candidate** at the [School of Artificial Intelligence, CUHK-Shenzhen](https://sai.cuhk.edu.cn/en/), advised by [Prof. Feng Yin](https://sai.cuhk.edu.cn/en/teacher/97) and [Prof. Tsung-Hui Chang](https://sai.cuhk.edu.cn/en/teacher/83). Before that, I did my BSc in Statistics (first-class honors) at CUHK-Shenzhen. Along the way I've interned at ByteDance, Huawei, and Dria.

### What I'm working on

My research is on **adaptive intelligence for sequential decision-making and optimization**. These are AI systems that learn probabilistic models of unknown environments, run informative experiments on a limited budget, and revise their hypotheses from feedback. Lately, the questions on my mind are

- How can models adapt their assumptions to the task when data and evaluations are limited?
- How can AI agents discover new algorithms and models that we can verify?
- How do we evaluate AI research systems on real problems and improve them from feedback?

More on my [research page](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/research/).

### Things I've built

| Project | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Kernaut](https://github.com/richardcsuwandi/kernaut) | Coding agents that discover new kernels as programs |
| [CAKE](https://github.com/richardcsuwandi/cake) | LLMs that evolve the kernel during Bayesian optimization (NeurIPS 2025) |
| [PlugBO](https://github.com/richardcsuwandi/plugbo) | A modular framework that lets an agent reconfigure Bayesian optimization on the fly |
| [OpenEvolve](https://github.com/algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve) | An open-source evolutionary coding agent for discovering and optimizing algorithms |
| [Kai](https://github.com/firstbatchxyz/kai) | An autonomous agent that evolves codebases by finding and patching vulnerabilities |
| [Sift](https://github.com/richardcsuwandi/sift) | A private, local AI copilot for searching and organizing your files |

### Around the community

I co-founded the [Institute for AI-Driven Discovery of Algorithms (AIDDA)](https://algorithmdiscovery.org/), I'm a dev ambassador at [Qwen](https://qwen.ai/), and I'm part of the [AIXI Labs](https://www.aixi.uk/) community. I also used to lead the AI4Science community at [alphaXiv](https://www.alphaxiv.org/).
